title: WSL distributions
whyItMatters: Each registered WSL distro holds a Linux filesystem with its own files and shell history. Missing it would leave a whole user environment unaccounted for.
source: Microsoft Learn: WSL distribution list under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Lxss - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/wsl/disk-space
notes: One GUID subkey per installed distribution. Names, BasePath values and VHD files are not read; only key, value and subkey counts are reported.

cleanup.exportFirst: Start each distribution and copy out the files and keys you still need; uninstalling deletes the whole file system.
steps: Copy out anything you still need from each distribution.
Uninstall the distribution from Settings > Apps > Installed apps, which also unregisters it.
Open Settings > Apps > Installed apps again and check that no Linux distribution is still listed.
cleanup.risk: Deletes each distribution's whole Linux file system: files, keys, code and shell history. Installed Windows programs are not affected.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Learn, Basic commands for WSL: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/wsl/basic-commands
